picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it the single largest concentration of DOE's new national AI-for-science initiative, signaling where federal AI research investment is concentrating.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the Genesis Mission, a whole-of-government initiative launched by executive order spanning 15+ federal agencies, marks a rare cross-agency policy commitment to AI-driven scientific discovery at the national level.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, shows AI-for-materials-discovery attracting serious private capital outside the government funding wave dominating this week's news.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's leadership on nine Genesis Mission projects plus contributions to 32 others makes it one of the two anchor national labs (alongside Berkeley) for the DOE's flagship AI initiative.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT's expanded AI/robotics partnership, with researchers rotating three months annually between CSAIL and MIRMI, is a concrete deepening of transatlantic academic collaboration backed by direct government funding.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: The Apertus 1.5 release from EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS adds multimodal capability to a fully open large language model trained on European supercomputing infrastructure, a notable counterweight to closed commercial AI models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: CMU researchers' finding that 3D genome architecture differs measurably in Alzheimer's patients, enabled by a new deep learning model, is a genuine scientific discovery with direct disease-mechanism implications rather than a funding announcement.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's SAGA tool, developed with YouTube and Google DeepMind, doesn't just detect AI-generated fake videos but identifies which generator made them, a practical advance for combating disinformation at real-world scale.
picks.title: New tool identifies the sources of fake videos

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node reflects a separate, parallel federal AI-for-science investment stream distinct from the DOE Genesis Mission awards dominating this week.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's new Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program shows Japan mounting its own national foundation-model initiative for scientific research, mirroring the US Genesis Mission on the international stage.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)
